stories.title: CM Yogi distributes nursing appointment letters to 1,100 women:Dy CM Pathak targets opponents, says era of job loot is over
stories.summary: Yogi Adityanath distributes joining letters to 1,097 female and 131 male nursing officers in Lucknow on Sunday, saying at a program held at Lok Bhawan that receiving appointment letters during Navratri reflects the growing strength of women. He said, The days are gone when it was believed that nothing would come of opening medical colleges or nursing colleges. Earlier, a parallel government of mafias used to run in medical colleges. Every department had a mafia. The department ran as he wished. Now, instead of mafias, 'One District, One Medical College' has been established. Meanwhile, Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak said, Nurses are made for service. So you should not get angry, you have to serve the patients. You people never worry. If there is any problem, tell us. You are like our family's daughters and brothers. Some have been posted far away. If you don't find a place to live, tell us too. Pathak also said- Earlier, people from the same community used to get jobs. Connections (jugaad) worked in every job, but now jobs are obtained through intellect and skill. Mafia who looted jobs are now fleeing to save their lives. Those who watched dances in Saifai. They are also troubled. In commerce, it is said - bad money drives good money out of circulation, so we have to go among the public and explain the difference. Now, 5 major points from Yogi's address 1. ‘Earlier hospitals ran on God’s mercy’ He said Indian nursing staff are in high demand globally (Japan, Germany, Korea, Europe). From 1947–2017, UP had only 17 medical colleges; now there are 81 (government + private). Earlier, the nursing and paramedical sectors were neglected, and hospital facilities depended largely on fate. 2. Story of Gorakhpur nursing school He recalled a nursing school in Gorakhpur that had only one faculty member. When the principal feared closure affecting 100 trainees, he arranged an honorarium to continue operations. He said 35 ANM/JNM institutes closed during the SP government are being revived, and construction of 31 nursing colleges has restarted. Nursing is the backbone of healthcare. 3. Major rise in medical seats He said healthcare improved under the double-engine government: maternal mortality now matches the national average; 3.5 crore people linked to Universal Health Coverage; 14 crore ABHA IDs created. Nursing seats increased by 7,000, paramedical by 2,000, MBBS seats from 5,390 to 12,700, and PG seats from 1,221 to 5,056. PPP-mode medical colleges are also running. 4. UP to supply nurses nationwide During Navratri, distributing appointment letters to many women reflects empowerment. With a population of 25 crore, UP aims to provide nursing manpower for the entire country. He suggested offering nursing education in multiple Indian languages like Tamil, Marathi, and Kannada. 5. ‘No discrimination in jobs or schemes’ He said reservation rules for SC, ST, and OBC are fully followed. In the last 9 years, 9 lakh government jobs have been provided without recommendation or transactions. Recruitment is done transparently through commissions under monitoring. Deputy CM highlights role of nurses Deployment in 14 districts including Kanpur The nursing officers who have received joining letters will be deployed in medical colleges of Agra, Kanpur, Prayagraj, Meerut, Jhansi, Gorakhpur, Ambedkarnagar, Kannauj, Azamgarh, Jalaun, Saharanpur, Banda and Badaun, along with JK Cancer Institute and Cardiology Institute, Kanpur.

stories.title: Fake IAS has married not once but 25 times:Victim's father alleges serial marriage fraud; vows to get justice for his daughter
stories.summary: He has married not once, but 25 times. He extorted money by posing as a fake IAS officer and also ruined my daughter's life. He left us with nothing. Every day a new story about him comes to light. This is what the father-in-law of the fake IAS officer, who lives in Gorakhpur, has to say. Half of his body is paralysed, and he remains confined to bed. Only a few years after suffering paralysis, another calamity struck, leaving the entire family shattered. On condition of anonymity, he told Dainik Bhaskar that he will not rest until the man who ruined his daughter’s life is punished. He also explained how the family fell into the fake IAS officer’s trap, how the relationship was arranged, and how the truth eventually came to light. The father-in-law of the fake IAS said, I have 3 daughters and one son. I have married off 2 daughters. Meanwhile, I became paralyzed. Half of my body doesn't work, so I started looking for a match for my youngest daughter. My youngest daughter has graduated. IAS profile shared in community group He said his elder daughter, who lives in Delhi, told him about a community group where someone shared the profile of an IAS officer named Pritam Kumar Nishad from Ludhiyat Mohalla in Etawah. The profile stated he was 32 years old and posted as an SDM in Manikpur, and that his family did not want dowry, only a beautiful bride. Hearing this, he felt the match was suitable and asked his daughter to proceed with the talks. Family visits Etawah to verify groom After his elder daughter spoke to Pritam Kumar Nishad about marriage, she arranged a phone conversation with him as well. He later visited Gorakhpur in December 2025, where the family met him, and he liked the girl upon seeing her. As talks progressed, family members went to Etawah to verify details. They found a 2BHK house in Ludhiyat Mohalla, where Pritam said he lived with his sister and that the house was in her name. He told them his financial condition had been poor earlier, but he was planning to sell the house and buy a new one. Dowry demand made before wedding When Pritam Kumar Nishad was asked about his village, he said it was 35 km away across a river and claimed it was very backward, adding he was the first boy from there to become an IAS officer. This helped him gain the family’s trust, and they were satisfied with the match. The wedding was fixed for March 11, 2026. Although he initially refused dowry, after the date was finalised, he demanded money, citing wedding and reception expenses, saying important guests would attend. At his insistence, ₹15 lakh was given to him one month before the wedding. 'Government of India' written on car Relatives expose groom’s fake identity Pritam showed videos in his defense The girl's father said that in his defense, Pritam provided a video. That video contained Pritam's interview. A YouTuber had interviewed him after he became an SDM, which had been running on his channel for four years. After this, Pritam said that his relatives are jealous and they don't want him to get married. After being convinced, the farewell ceremony was completed on March 12, 2026. Villagers called and revealed the truth The girl's father said that shortly after, several more calls came from Pritam's village. They also provided proof of Pritam's fraud. They said that Pritam had run away from the village. He has defrauded many people. He has married 25 times by lying. Reached groom’s house after farewell The girl’s father said they were frightened after the farewell and asked their daughter to keep sharing her location. Three hours later, his son, nephew, and elder daughter left Gorakhpur by car. Pritam Kumar Nishad reached his house in Ludhiyat Mohalla, Etawah, around 9 PM, while the girl’s family arrived at 11 PM. They found people at his house intoxicated, and Pritam himself returned with red eyes. Truth revealed after interrogation SSP Dr. Kaustubh said, A case has been registered. After investigating the family's allegations, action will be taken against the accused.

stories.title: New claims in Farsa Baba death case:Disciples allege truck ran him over intentionally; questions raised over police hiding the container
stories.summary: Whether the death of Farsa Wale Baba aka Chandrashekhar Singh (45) in Mathura is an accident or murder... this mystery is getting more complicated. Baba's supporters are calling it murder, while police are saying it was an accident. According to the theory stated by police the Baba was checking a container with Nagaland number plate when a truck bearing Rajasthan number plate hit the container from behind. Baba died after being caught in the collision. Baba received information that cattle was being transported by truck Supporters stated that Baba had received information regarding cattle being transported by truck. He chased the truck on a bike with his two companions. They overtook and stood in front of it. They started checking the container. That's when a truck coming from behind deliberately crushed Baba. Baba's companions were also targeted but they narrowly escaped. However, the DIG stated, There were no cattle in the trucks. The Nagaland number truck contained soap-shampoo and the Rajasthan number truck had oil. The Rajasthan number truck was damaged in the accident. The driver died during treatment, while regarding the container and its location This has not been traced yet". In this situation, Baba's supporters have raised questions that if the container really had soap-shampoo, why did the police keep it in an unknown location? They said that CCTV footage from the highway will reveal the truth. Read what the disciples who accompanied Baba said. Hariom said – the collision was deliberate, the container had cows Hariom, a disciple who lives at Baba’s cowshed, said, “Around 3 am on Saturday someone called Farsa Wale Baba and informed him that cattle were being transported from the National Highway near Kosi. After receiving the information, Baba took me and Kanha on his motorcycle and reached the spot”. He added, “As soon as Baba arrived, a container with a Nagaland registration number started speeding towards Delhi. Baba chased it and stopped it near the Navipur area”. He further stated, “Baba got down from the bike and was checking the container when a truck with a Rajasthan number coming from behind rammed into him at high speed. It wanted to crush all of us, but Baba pushed us away and came under the truck himself”. He also said, “If there was nothing illegal in the container, why did the people inside try to flee?” He claimed that the container was carrying cows. That is why the truck moving behind deliberately hit Baba. Another companion said - There was adequate light at the accident spot Kanha, another companion who was with Baba, said, “You can go and see how much light there is at the place where the incident occurred. The truck running in the middle directly hit Maharaj Ji after seeing him. Maharaj Ji didn't get a chance. After the collision, the container people ran away. They were Muslims, that's why the police let them go. Otherwise, the public would have killed them”. He added, “Maharaj Ji used to go on patrol every day. This is just a conspiracy. At this same point, three years ago, Sonu Sarpanch, who was involved in cow protection, was also killed. Kanha claims that if the administration checks CCTV footage, it will show that there were cows in that vehicle. Why hasn't the police shown the recovery of the container yet”. Now find out what the police and administration are saying Who is Farsa Wale Baba? Chandrashekhar Baba's home is in Ajnaukh village in the Chhata area on Barsana Road in Mathura. He has been serving cows for many years. Local people say, “Farsa Wale Baba was always dedicated to cows. Initially, whenever there was any problem regarding cows in the Barsana area, people would tell Baba. He gradually became famous in the area by helping cows”. Farsa Wale Baba, who dedicated his life to cow service, was so feared among smugglers that as soon as they learned of his presence, they would abandon the illegally transported cattle and run away. Baba's elder brother Keshav Singh said, “Younger brother was 45 years old. Originally from Sirsaganj Langra of Firozabad. He had become a Baba at the age of 10. In the family, we were the only two brothers. I have 4 sons, 4 daughters-in-law, 7 grandsons and 6 granddaughters. Baba never married”. He further stated, “We live in Ayodhya. Earlier, Baba also used to live with us in Ayodhya. Later he came to Mathura”. He has also demanded death penalty for the culprits. Understand the complete matter... Farsa Wale Baba died after being crushed by a truck in Kosikalan's Kotvan police station area on Saturday. A video has emerged after the accident. In this, Baba is lying on the ground. A sword with its sheath is lying near him. The front part of the Rajasthan number truck appears damaged. Its driver Khurshid, a resident of Alwar, also died during treatment in Agra. News of the incident spread like wildfire in the area. Thousands of people came out on the highway in Mathura's Chhata town. Angry people placed Baba's body and blocked the Delhi-Kolkata highway. They started demanding encounter of the accused. The police who arrived to take possession of the body and clear the traffic jam were chased away by people. They also pelted stones, in which some policemen were injured. People vandalized 5 to 6 police vehicles. Windows were broken. Seeing the situation getting out of control, police resorted to lathi charge. Tear gas shells were fired. CM Yogi took cognizance of the matter Meanwhile, people took Baba's body to the gaushala located in Ajnaukh village. They put forward 6 demands including building a memorial for Baba before the administration. The DM assured that a memorial site will be built at the place of Baba's cremation. After this, Baba's last rites were performed. CM Yogi also took cognizance of the matter. While directing officials to take strict action, he said, “The accused will not be spared”. Meanwhile, late Saturday night, 16 rioters including Hindu Raksha Dal worker Daksh Chaudhary have been arrested for causing disturbance regarding Farsa Baba's death.

stories.summary: The accused in the murder of a student at UP College in Varanasi was produced in court under tight security on Saturday evening. Police feared that lawyers and students might assault the accused. Therefore, the police tried to make him run, but he stumbled because his leg was fractured. Following this, police personnel carried him into the courtroom. The Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM) sent Manjeet to jail for 14 days. Police had arrested Manjeet on Friday for the murder of student Surya Pratap Singh. However, his associate Anuj Singh, who allegedly helped him, is still absconding. See Manjeet's court appearance in 2 pictures... Manjeet said - Student used to do ragging Police interrogated the accused named Manjeet Chauhan before presenting him in court. During this, he revealed that Surya Pratap Singh along with his friends used to rag him. Manjeet said, “Surya Pratap Singh and his associates often troubled me and my friends in the name of ragging. They would physically assault us. On the day of the incident, March 20, we also had an argument on the college campus. There were threats and intimidation”. He added, “In anger and revenge, along with my companion Anuj Singh, I fired 4-5 rounds at Surya Pratap near the administrative building. This resulted in his death”. Sharp argument between protesting students and ADM Meanwhile, on Saturday (March 21), ADM Alok Verma reached to persuade the students who were protesting against Surya Pratap's murder at UP College. During the talks, there was a sharp argument between ADM and the students. After this, the students put forward 5 demands. The officials assured to take the charter of demands from the students and send it to the government. These 5 demands were put forward by students to ADM Now know the complete matter... Student had returned to college on Friday after 20 days The deceased father Rishi Dev Singh is a driver at Atulanand School. His mother Kiran Singh is an assistant at Atulanand School. Surya has two sisters, one is married while the other sister is still studying. Surya Pratap had chickenpox 20 days ago. Due to this, he was not coming to college. After recovering, he came to college on March 20 only. That's when he was murdered. Crime Scene and Subsequent Events… It was 11 o'clock in the morning. Students were studying in their respective classes. Suddenly, BSc student Surya Pratap Singh was shot and killed on the college campus. BA second-year student Manjeet Singh Chauhan shot him in filmy style in front of the principal and students. A student recorded a video of the live incident. After the murder, the accused fled after throwing the pistol in a garbage heap. After this, everyone had just one question in their mind that why did Manjeet kill Surya? It was reported that Surya used to call senior students to the hostel. He would rag junior students. Manjeet had complained about this to the principal. The principal had summoned both of them. On Friday, after meeting with the principal, there was a dispute between Manjeet and Surya. In which Manjeet rolled up his shirt sleeves, then Surya grabbed Manjeet's collar while hurling abuses. At that time, friends intervened and stopped them. Manjeet went to his home. From there, he came to college with a pistol along with a friend. He parked his Pulsar bike near the gate outside the college. Then, as soon as he saw Surya in the arts faculty corridor, he opened fire on him. He fell down, yet he continued shooting at him with the pistol. Manjeet's leg broke after jumping from 12 feet height After the murder, Manjeet felt that he would be caught if he escaped through the gate, so he jumped from the roof to avoid this. His leg broke when he jumped from a height of about 12 feet. His bike was parked at the gate, but seeing himself surrounded, he ran towards Airport Road even with his broken leg. He took a lift in an e-rickshaw to reach Gilt Bazar intersection and then turned off his phone. After this, he tried to get treatment after reaching a deserted place. After breaking his leg, he could not flee outside the city. Meanwhile, police pressured the family members for his arrest. Angry students created ruckus in college premises After the incident, angry students created a ruckus on the college campus. They broke chairs inside the campus. After about 4 hours, the police got the college gate opened. Students and teachers were evacuated from the college by forming a cordon. Three professors were injured in stone pelting by students. Police chased away the protesting students with lathi charge. Meanwhile, parents fainted upon seeing the body of their only son. Now know about Surya Pratap Singh... 21-year-old Surya Pratap Singh was from Ghazipur district. He completed his education till 8th standard from Ghazipur. He came to UP College to study from 9th standard. Since then, he had been studying here. He was very talented in studies. He passed his 12th examination in PCM from UP College itself with first division. Then he cleared the entrance exam and got admission in BSc Mathematics here. Fellow students said that he was very friendly. He kept himself busy with studies. After BSc, he wanted to do research in MSc Mathematics from here. His dream was to go into academics. Case registered against accused Manjeet Chauhan The accused student Manjeet Chauhan is a BA second year student. Manjeet is from Chandmari area of Varanasi itself. He already had a case under section 323 registered at Shivpur police station, while his associate Anuj also has several cases registered against him. The accused, who gets into fights over small matters, is of an aggressive nature. He has a bad boy image on social media. He calls himself a mafia on Instagram. He is also well-known in local police stations like Bhojubir, Shivpur and Bada Lalpur. He runs an 1818 gang on social media. He had written in his Instagram bio “Your respect remains only as long as it doesn't hurt my self-respect. Jai Maa Bhawani”.

stories.title: Film ‘Dhurandhar’ sparks row over Atiq Ahmed portrayal:Chargesheet in Umesh Pal Murder mentions Pakistan link
stories.summary: A brief 7–8-minute appearance by a character named Atif Ahmed in the film Dhurandhar: The Revenge has sparked a political and factual debate. The reel character closely resembles the real-life mafia don Atiq Ahmed from Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. The film recreates his murder in a manner strikingly similar to the killing of Atiq and his brother Ashraf in April 2023, while attributing the sequence of events to a conspiracy involving National Security Advisor Ajay Sanyal. In contrast, in Uttar Pradesh, it is widely believed that the decline of mafia dominance, including that of Atiq, resulted from CM Yogi Adityanath’s stringent crackdown. The film also portrays Atif Ahmed as having links with Pakistan’s intelligence agency ISI, depicting him as a major arms supplier, counterfeit currency operator, and political influencer. These claims have led leaders from the Congress and Samajwadi Party to label the film as propaganda. Former SP MP Dr. S.T. Hasan stated that no Indian investigative agency has confirmed such allegations, calling it an attempt to generate controversy for publicity. Amidst these claims, here is a breakdown of what the film shows versus documented realities. Fact 1: Alleged ISI links and arms supply Film portrayal: The film depicts Atif Ahmed procuring AK-47 rifles through Pakistan’s ISI, facilitated by Baloch mafia networks. Reality: Atiq Ahmed was murdered on 15 April 2023. Fifteen days earlier, Prayagraj Police filed a chargesheet in the Umesh Pal murder case, naming Atiq and his brother Ashraf in arms trafficking. According to the document, Atiq claimed he had ample access to weapons and acknowledged links with ISI and Lashkar-e-Taiba operatives. The chargesheet states that weapons were airdropped via drones in Punjab and then routed through local agents to Atiq’s network. The same consignments allegedly reached militants in Jammu and Kashmir. Atiq also indicated possible recovery points for weapons. Based on these statements, police registered an FIR mentioning ISI-supplied arms, including AK-47 rifles, a .45 bore pistol, a sten gun, and even RDX. A .45 pistol was reportedly used in the Umesh Pal murder, while 58 Pakistan-made 9mm cartridges were recovered. Fact 2: Criminal network operated from jail Film portrayal: Atif Ahmed is shown managing his operations from inside prison, coordinating with ISI officials and directing smuggling activities, including drugs via Nepal. Reality: This aspect aligns closely with documented incidents. Following the 2007 Raju Pal murder, Atiq spent most of his time in various prisons, including Naini (Prayagraj), Deoria, Banda, and Chitrakoot. In April 2013, while lodged in Deoria Jail, Atiq’s associates abducted Lucknow-based businessman Mohit Jaiswal and brought him into the prison. There, Jaiswal was brutally assaulted, suffering fractures in his fingers, and coerced into transferring ownership of his companies, MJ Infra, to associates Farooq and Zaki. The case gained national attention, leading to Atiq’s transfer to Bareilly Jail in December 2018 and subsequently to Sabarmati Jail in Gujarat in 2019. Fact 3: Counterfeit currency via Nepal route Film portrayal: The narrative links Atif Ahmed to a massive counterfeit currency operation orchestrated by Dawood Ibrahim, prompting the Indian government’s demonetisation move in November 2016. Reality: No formal case was registered against Atiq Ahmed for circulating fake Pakistani currency through Nepal into Uttar Pradesh. However, multiple cases involving hawala transactions were filed. Investigations revealed that Atiq was involved in extortion, routing funds through shell companies, transferring them abroad, and reintroducing them into India via alternative channels. Fact 4: Political influence in UP Film portrayal: The film suggests that Atif Ahmed played a role in influencing government formation in Uttar Pradesh. Reality: Atiq Ahmed did wield significant political influence. He was first elected MLA from Allahabad West in 1989 and retained the seat in 1991, 1993, 1996, and 2002. In 2004, he became an MP from Phulpur on a Samajwadi Party ticket. Even after imprisonment in the Raju Pal murder case, he remained politically active. However, there is no evidence supporting two key cinematic claims: that his political rise was funded by counterfeit currency operations, or that he directly influenced the formation of state governments. Why is the film being called propaganda ? Former IPS officer Lalji Shukla, who investigated multiple cases involving Atiq during his tenure in Prayagraj, offered a nuanced perspective. He acknowledged that counterfeit currency does enter India from Pakistan, often through Bangladesh and Nepal routes, and noted that such consignments were intercepted during his posting in Bahraich. However, he clarified that Atiq’s name never directly surfaced in these cases. On weapons, Shukla stated that Atiq had a known fascination with firearms and that multiple weapons were seized from him over time, including a .30 pistol licensed in another individual’s name. He added that while the film draws inspiration from reality, it cannot be treated as factual. Individuals involved in violent crime may also engage in smuggling or financial crimes, but such links must be proven. Senior journalist and writer Manoj Rajan Tripathi also emphasised the film’s disclaimer stating that any resemblance to real individuals is coincidental. He pointed out that despite over 175 cases registered against Atiq, none conclusively established arms smuggling from Pakistan during his lifetime. Tripathi further noted that the film focuses on selective elements while omitting major incidents, including the Raju Pal and Umesh Pal murder cases and other serious allegations. As such, he argues, Dhurandhar: The Revenge should be viewed as a dramatised narrative rather than a factual account.

stories.title: Man poses as IAS for marriage, plans to sell bride:Organised grand wedding in Gorakhpur, flees when exposed
stories.summary: A shocking case has emerged from Gorakhpur, where a man from Etawah allegedly posed as an IAS officer to marry a woman and later planned to sell her in Goa. The accused, identified as Pritam Nishad, managed to deceive the bride’s family with fake credentials before his identity was exposed. Grand wedding, heavy expenses The marriage was solemnized with great pomp at a marriage lawn in the Nandanagar area. The bride’s family reportedly spent around ₹30 lakh on the wedding, including ₹15 lakh in cash given as dowry. After the wedding, the bride’s father filed a complaint at the Cantt police station in Gorakhpur against the accused and his family. Fraudulent claims and fake proof The victim’s family, residents of Mohaddipur, came into contact with Pritam through a matrimonial group. He claimed to be an IAS officer posted in Manikpur. To gain trust, he shared alleged news channel interviews, photos of an office setup, and images with political leaders. Demanded money before marriage Although Pritam initially claimed he would marry without dowry, he later demanded ₹15 lakh before the engagement under the pretext of expenses. The family paid ₹10 lakh during the engagement and the remaining ₹5 lakh on the wedding day. Truth revealed after wedding On March 11, 2026, the wedding took place at Durga Marriage Lawn in Nandanagar. The next day, after the groom’s party departed, someone informed the bride’s family that he was not an IAS officer. When the family reached the address given by the accused, they found their daughter in a small room. The accused and his sister fled upon seeing them. Allegation of trafficking plan After returning home, the bride revealed that the accused was allegedly planning to take her to Goa and sell her. The family has accused him of being a habitual fraudster who uses fake identities and documents to deceive people. There are also suspicions of his involvement in human trafficking. Police investigation underway According to Senior Superintendent of Police Dr. Kaustubh, a case has been registered and an investigation is underway. Authorities have assured that strict action will be taken after verifying all allegations.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Cow vigilante's death triggers 10 km jam in Mathura; PM Modi stresses to keep sea routes open
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Modi dials Iranian President, stresses to keep sea routes open The US-Israel-Iran war has entered its 22nd day. On Saturday, the Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with the Iranian President over the phone and extended greetings on Eid and Nowruz. During the conversation, he condemned attacks on critical infrastructure in the region, noting that they harm regional stability and disrupt global supply chains. 2. Cow vigilante's death triggers 10 km highway blockade in Mathura, cops injured in stone-pelting Cow vigilante Chandrashekhar Baba, popularly known as 'Farsa Wale Baba', died after being run over by a truck in Mathura. One of his associates claimed that early Saturday morning, Baba was chasing a truck along with two companions after suspecting it was transporting cattle. 3. RSS urges UP ministers, MLAs to avoid controversial statements The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has asked ministers and MLAs of the Uttar Pradesh Government to improve their working style and avoid making controversial statements against the government. 4. BJP releases new candidate list for Kerala, Assam and Puducherry Bharatiya Janata Party on Saturday released fresh lists of candidates for upcoming assembly elections in Kerala, Assam and Puducherry. The party announced nine candidates for the Puducherry Assembly elections. It also released the third list of 11 candidates for the Kerala Assembly polls. Additionally, the BJP issued a list of two candidates for the Assam Assembly elections. 5. Akhilesh Yadav joins massive Eid gathering in Lucknow Eid is being celebrated in UP today. Amid high alert, Eid prayers will be offered at different times at Eidgahs in Lucknow. More than 50 thousand people are offering prayers at Aishbagh Eidgah. Meanwhile, former CM Akhilesh Yadav, former Deputy CM Dinesh Sharma, and Congress state president Ajay Rai have arrived. 6. BSc student's cremated in midnight in Varanasi The last rites of BSc student Surya Pratap Singh (21) from UP College in Varanasi were performed at 12:30 am. His father had insisted that the accused be killed in an encounter before the cremation. Police officials somehow convinced him. 7. Airlines warn of airfare hike, blames it on Centre Indigo, Air India, and SpiceJet have opposed the government's decision not to charge extra for 60% of flight seats. Airlines say that this move will force them to increase airfares to compensate for their lost revenue. 8. Sanjay Nishad targets 160 seats in UP election: Focus on Kevat-Mallah community votes Nishad Party is going to launch its election rally from Gorakhpur. After this, there will be 3 more mega rallies. The party wants to focus on 160 Kevat-Mallah dominated seats in UP. 9. Train coach restaurant shuts down in Lucknow A unique restaurant operating out of a rail coach near Charbagh Railway Station in Lucknow has been forced to halt most of its operations due to a shortage of commercial gas cylinders. 10. Asim Munir threatens Shia clerics at iftar, says ‘go to Iran if you love it’ Pakistan’s army chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir, told Shia clerics that those who “love Iran so much should go there,” a statement Shia leaders described as insulting and provocative.

stories.title: ग्राइंडर ऐप पर हुई दोस्ती, होटल बुलाकर जमकर की युवक की पिटाई, फिर बनाई अश्लील वीडियो
stories.summary: Lucknow News: लखनऊ में एक युवक के साथ एक हादसा हो गया। उसे ग्राइंडर नाम के डेटिंग ऐप पर दोस्ती के बहाने होटल बुलाया गया। वहां जाकर उसके अश्लील वीडियो बना लिए गए। जब उसने मना किया तो उसे जमकर पीटा गया और 35 हजार रुपये लूट लिए गए। पुलिस ने इस मामले में केस दर्ज किया है और जांच शुरू कर दी है। पीड़ित युवक बीकेटी इलाके का रहने वाला है। उसकी मुलाकात ग्राइंडर ऐप पर अलीगंज के रहने वाले अभिषेक वर्मा से हुई थी। दोनों ने ऐप पर बातचीत शुरू की और धीरे-धीरे दोस्ती हो गई। अभिषेक ने युवक को होटल में मिलने के लिए बुलाया। युवक को लगा कि यह सिर्फ मिलने-जुलने की बात है, इसलिए वह गुरुवार को होटल गैलेक्सी पहुंच गया। यह होटल जीसीआरजी कॉलेज के पास बीकेटी इलाके में स्थित है। अभिषेक इसी होटल में काम करता है।

stories.title: Train coach restaurant shuts down in Lucknow:Manager says, 'No gas supply since March 3, causing daily losses of ₹20,000'
stories.summary: A unique restaurant operating out of a rail coach near Charbagh Railway Station in Lucknow has been forced to halt most of its operations due to a shortage of commercial gas cylinders. Since March 3, the restaurant has not received any gas supply, leaving most of its kitchen stoves non-functional. Only coal-fired furnaces and tandoors are currently in use, severely limiting food preparation. Limited menu, reduced workforce With only coal-based cooking available, the restaurant is now serving a restricted menu. As a result, half of its staff has been asked to take leave. Out of 14 employees, only 7 are currently working. Head chef Vijay Kashyap said that operations have been severely impacted over the past 10 days, making it difficult to prepare meals efficiently. Daily losses of ₹20,000 Restaurant manager Vimlesh stated that the lack of gas supply has led to significant financial losses, estimated at around ₹20,000 per day. “If we don’t receive gas cylinders soon, we may have no option but to shut down the restaurant completely,” he said, adding that all gas stoves remain idle. Customers turning away disappointed Once a bustling spot, especially during nighttime with heavy footfall from passengers and locals, the restaurant is now witnessing a sharp decline in customers. Most menu items are unavailable, leading to disappointed customers returning without dining. The limited food options from tandoor and coal furnaces have also affected the restaurant’s reputation and customer trust. Livelihoods at risk The crisis has extended beyond business losses, impacting the livelihoods of employees and their families. Chef Vijay Kashyap highlighted that many workers depended solely on this job for their income. With reduced operations and staff cuts, their financial stability is now at risk. Customers are returning disappointed Earlier, the restaurant was always crowded with customers. Especially at night, it was a gathering place for travelers and locals. Now the situation has changed. Most of the menu items are not available, causing customers to return disappointed. Due to limited food being prepared in the tandoor-oven, both the identity and trust of the restaurant are being affected. Uncertain future The management fears that if gas supply is not restored soon, the rail coach restaurant may have to shut down temporarily. With expenses continuing despite declining revenue, the key question remains: how long can the business sustain these losses?

stories.summary: Eid is being celebrated in UP today. Amid high alert, Eid prayers will be offered at different times at Eidgahs in Lucknow. More than 50 thousand people are offering prayers at Aishbagh Eidgah. Meanwhile, former CM Akhilesh Yadav, former Deputy CM Dinesh Sharma, and Congress state president Ajay Rai have arrived. Islamic Center of India President Maulana Khalid Rashid has appealed to people not to worship on roads. The Eid moon was sighted in Lucknow on Friday. After this, it was announced to celebrate Eid in all mosques of UP, including Eidgah Aishbagh. The moon was not visible on Thursday, the 29th of Ramadan, so the moon was confirmed on Friday, the 30th of Ramadan. Follow the guidelines issued for prayers. Do not try to worship on the road. Maulana extended Eid greetings to all countrymen.

stories.title: Cow vigilante's death triggers 10 km highway blockade in Mathura:Policemen injured in stone-pelting; crowd claims smugglers ran over him
stories.summary: Cow vigilante Chandrashekhar Baba, popularly known as 'Farsa Wale Baba', died after being run over by a truck in Mathura. One of his associates claimed that early Saturday morning, Baba was chasing a truck along with two companions after suspecting it was transporting cattle. After overtaking the vehicle, Baba parked his bike in front of it, but the driver allegedly sped up and ran over him before fleeing. Baba died on the spot. Crowd demanding an encounter As news of the incident spread, thousands gathered on the Delhi–Mathura Highway, demanding an encounter against the accused and blocking traffic. When police reached the site to clear the blockade, protesters chased them away and resorted to stone-pelting, leaving several personnel injured. Protesters also vandalised 5–6 police vehicles, smashing their windows. Firing was also reported during the unrest. Police later carried out a lathi-charge and used tear gas shells to bring the situation under control. Meanwhile, Yogi Adityanath took cognisance of the incident and directed officials to take strict action, stating that the accused would not be spared. However, Shailesh Pandey said Baba had stopped a truck on suspicion and was checking it when another truck coming from behind hit the stationary vehicle due to dense morning fog, leading to the accident. He clarified that no cattle were found in the trucks and warned that action would be taken against those involved in the violence. Notably, about 25 km from the protest site, Droupadi Murmu was present in the area and was performing parikrama of Govardhan Hill. The incident falls under the Kosi and Chhata police station areas.

stories.title: BSc student cremated in midnight in Varanasi:Accused called himself 'dabang', added 'mafia' to his name; college murder video surfaces
stories.summary: The last rites of BSc student Surya Pratap Singh (21) from UP College in Varanasi were performed at 12:30 am. His father had insisted that the accused be killed in an encounter before the cremation. Police officials somehow convinced him. After the postmortem at around 9 pm, police took the body directly to Harishchandra Ghat. An inspector himself accompanied the body in the ambulance. There, the father performed the last rites of his only son. On the way, some students protested against taking the body straight to the ghat, but the police dispersed them by using force. Earlier, police had arrested the accused student, Manjeet Singh Chauhan (21), late at night. After the murder, he jumped over the boundary wall to escape, during which he fractured one leg. He is being questioned at Shivpur police station. The incident took place at around 11:30 am on Friday inside UP College (Uday Pratap College), where a BA student, Manjeet, shot and killed Surya Pratap. A video of the incident also surfaced in the evening, showing Surya lying on the ground while Manjeet climbed on his chest and shot him. The motive behind the crime is believed to be linked to a ragging dispute and rivalry. While Manjeet is said to have a criminal mindset, Surya was academically bright. The two had been in conflict for the past three months. On Friday, the college principal had called both of them to his office, where they again got into an argument. During this, Surya reportedly threatened him, which angered Manjeet. Shortly afterwards, the murder was carried out. Dispute was going on for 3 months While Manjeet had a criminal mind, Surya was good at studies. The dispute between them had been going on for three months. On Friday, the principal called both of them to his office. They argued there as well. During this, Surya Pratap threatened to deal with him. This threat did not go well with Manjeet. Read the full report… First, know about the crime scene and subsequent events... It was 11 o'clock in the morning. Students were studying in their respective classes. Suddenly, BSc student Surya Pratap Singh was shot dead in the college premises. BA second-year student Manjeet Singh Chauhan shot him in filmy style in front of the principal and students. A student recorded a video of the live incident. After the murder, the accused fled after throwing the pistol in a garbage heap. After this, everyone had one question: why did Manjeet kill Surya? It was reported that Surya used to call senior students in the hostel. He used to rag junior students. Manjeet had complained about this to the principal. The principal had summoned both of them. On Friday, after meeting the principal, there was a dispute between Manjeet and Surya. In which Manjeet rolled up his shirt sleeves, at this, Surya grabbed Manjeet's collar while hurling abuses. At that time, friends intervened to stop the fight. Manjeet went to his home. From there, he came to college with a pistol along with a friend. He parked his Pulsar bike near the gate outside the college. Then, upon seeing Surya in the arts faculty corridor, he opened fire on him. He fell down, but Manjeet continued shooting him with the pistol. Manjeet's leg broke after jumping from a height of 12 feet After the murder, Manjeet felt that he would be caught if he escaped through the gate, so he jumped from the roof to avoid this. His leg broke after jumping from about 12 feet high. His bike was parked at the gate, but seeing himself surrounded, he ran towards the airport road, even with his broken leg. Taking a lift from an e-rickshaw, he reached Gilt Bazaar intersection and then turned off the phone. After this, he tried to get treatment after reaching a deserted place. After breaking his leg, he could not flee outside the city. Meanwhile, police pressured his family members for his arrest. Angry students created a ruckus in college premises After the incident, angry students created a ruckus in the college premises. They broke chairs inside the campus. After about 4 hours, the police got the college gate open. Students and teachers were evacuated from the college by forming a cordon. Three professors were injured in a student stone- pelting. Police dispersed the protesting students with a lathi charge. Meanwhile, parents fainted upon seeing the body of their only son. Father sat on ground after seeing the body Late at night, Surya Pratap Singh's father, Rishi Dev Singh, arrived in Varanasi from Lucknow. At the BHU postmortem house, villagers said to take one last look at your son, but the father couldn't gather the courage. Later, people helped the father have a final glimpse of his son. Father had said, ‘Will only perform last rites after encounter’ Father Rishi Dev Singh had said - Police should encounter that boy, only then we will perform our boy's funeral. Our boy talked to us yesterday (Thursday), there was no problem then. There was no fight with anyone. We learned that the principal had called to school for reconciliation, but we never thought our boy would be murdered. Now know about Surya Pratap Singh... 21-year-old Surya Pratap Singh was from Ghazipur district. He completed his education till 8th from Ghazipur. He came to UP College to study from the 9th grade. Since then, he has been studying here. Surya Pratap Singh was very talented in his studies. He passed 12th with PCM from UP College itself with first division. Then he cleared the entrance exam and got admission in BSc Mathematics here. Fellow students said that Surya Pratap Singh was very friendly. He kept himself busy with studies. After his BSc, he wanted to do research in MSc Mathematics here. His dream was to go into academics. Student Surya Pratap Singh's father, Rishi Dev Singh, is a driver at a travel agency in Lucknow. His mother, Kiran Singh, works as an assistant in a school. The student has two sisters, one of whom is married, while the other is unmarried. Surya Pratap had chickenpox 20 days ago, due to which he was not coming to college. After recovering, he had just come to college today. Case registered against accused Manjeet Chauhan The accused student, Manjeet Chauhan, is a BA second-year student. Manjeet is a resident of Chandmari in Varanasi. He already had a case registered under section 323 at Shivpur police station, while his associate Anuj also has several cases registered against him. Manjeet Chauhan, who gets into fights over small matters, is of an aggressive nature. He has a bad boy image on social media. He portrays himself as a mafia on Instagram. Manjeet Chauhan is also well-known in local police stations like Bhojubir, Shivpur, and Bada Lalpur. He runs an 1818 gang on social media. In his Instagram bio, he has written - Your respect remains only as long as it doesn't hurt my self-respect. Jai Maa Bhavani. DCP Pramod Kumar of Varuna Zone said- The accused student Manjeet Chauhan, who shot and killed student Surya Pratap Singh in UP College this morning, has been caught. His leg is broken. His accomplice is being searched for. Accused Manjeet is being interrogated.

stories.title: RSS urges UP ministers, MLAs to avoid controversial statements:Advises to improve working style coordination with party workers
stories.summary: The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has asked ministers and MLAs of the Uttar Pradesh Government to improve their working style and avoid making controversial statements against the government. A four-and-a-half-hour meeting was held at the residence of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Friday at 3 PM, where discussions focused on addressing workers’ dissatisfaction ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Those present included Deputy CMs Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak, RSS Sah Sarkaryavah Arun Kumar, Bharatiya Janata Party state president Pankaj Chaudhary, organisation general secretary Dharampal Singh, RSS Eastern Region Pracharak Anil Kumar, Western Region Pracharak Mahendra Kumar, and pracharaks from all six provinces. Key points of the meeting 1. Organisation-related work is not happening 2. Atmosphere deteriorated due to MLAs' statements 3. Unity should be visible in RSS, Government, and BJP 4. Make nationalism an issue instead of caste 5. Commission to respond in court on Panchayat elections Core committee meeting to be held tomorrow The core committee meeting will be held on Saturday in the presence of CM Yogi Adityanath and RSS Sah-Sarkaryavah Arun Kumar. In the core committee, a future roadmap will be prepared based on the issues that emerged during the meeting of the Sangh, government, and BJP on Friday. Additionally, there will be deliberation on the upcoming cabinet expansion and the formation of the state BJP's new team. Ministers will also be assigned tasks in the cabinet meeting to be held on Monday.

stories.title: Sanjay Nishad targets 160 seats in UP election:Focus on Kevat-Mallah community votes; push for SC status ahead of polls
stories.summary: Nishad Party is going to launch its election rally from Gorakhpur. After this, there will be 3 more mega rallies. The party wants to focus on 160 Kevat-Mallah dominated seats in UP. The party will raise 4 major demands in the rallies. Most importantly, it will create an atmosphere for including Kevat-Mallah in Scheduled Caste from OBC. What political message does Nishad Party want to convey through 4 rallies? Is it easy to get Kevat-Mallah registered from OBC to SC? How influential are Nishads in UP? Read in this report... Learn why these four rally locations are important Gorakhpur. The Nishad Party was founded here. Party's national president Sanjay Nishad belongs to this district. Nishad Party got its first political success from Gorakhpur seat in the 2018 Lok Sabha by-election. This seat had become vacant after Yogi Adityanath was chosen as CM. Shringverpur of Prayagraj: Has the confluence of Ganga-Yamuna. A grand statue of Lord Ram and his friend Nishad Raj is installed here. The government has also built a Nishad Raj Park in 100 acres in Shringverpur. The largest population of Kevat-Mallah lives in the Ganga-Yamuna belt. Varanasi: Is PM Narendra Modi's parliamentary constituency. The political message of the crowd that gathered at the rally here will go far. A large population of Kevat-Mallah also lives in Varanasi and surrounding districts. Meerut: From Delhi NCR to this Ganga belt, Kashyap community lives in large numbers. Hastinapur is also near Meerut. The Nishad Party intends to expand by showing strength in this belt. What are the 4 major demands of Nishad Party 1. Include Nishad in SC instead of OBC: This was the very foundation of the party's formation. Even during the alliance with SP, Nishad Party joined with this demand. Then the alliance with BJP was also formed on this condition. In between, while being in the alliance, Nishad Party gave slogans like 'No reservation, No vote' and 'Implement Majhwar reservation'. Reduce 9% reservation from OBC and add it to SC. Cabinet Minister Sanjay Nishad says- Through four rallies in UP, I want to tell the Nishad-Kewat-Mallah communities that your rights are not being taken by upper caste people. Rather, your share is being taken by Leatherman (Dalit) and Milkman (Yadav). Sanjay Nishad further says - Through the rally, we will tell our community that census is starting in the country from May 22. This time there will also be a caste census. The first task is to get your family name removed from OBC and register it under SC (Majhwar) at point number 12 in the census register. 2. First right on riverbanks, ghats and sand contracts: According to Nishad Party, their community had fought against the British. Due to this, their ancestral lands were taken away. Our community lives by the river. Therefore, sand contracts should also be given on first priority, government can take royalty if they want. 3. Rights on Land: Sanjay Nishad says that previously village ponds and ghats were recorded in class-3. The Nishad community had ownership rights over these. But in 2007 when BSP government was formed in UP, these ownership rights were taken away. We got this rule nullified through court. During Mayawati's rule we had also obtained a stay order, which we got dismissed. 4. Benefits of Denotified Tribe Status: Kevat-Mallah and other castes have been declared as denotified tribes by the Government of India. They were to be connected to mainstream society by providing them 74 types of facilities. But in 2013, the SP government took away these rights as well. Sanjay Nishad says- "SP took away education. BSP took away livelihood. Until you let leaders of such parties enter the village, you won't get your share. Only when you drive them away will they realize their mistake. Whenever I speak about this in the house, leaders of both these parties try to suppress our voice." What does Nishad Party want to achieve through 4 rallies We understood from Nishad Party President Sanjay Nishad and two political experts how successful the Nishad Party will be in showing its strength through 4 rallies in UP... Dr. Sanjay Nishad says - Through the rally, we want to make our community aware and organized. The party has invited 100 people from each assembly constituency to all rallies. Along with this, NDA allies like Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party's Om Prakash Rajbhar and Apna Dal (S)'s Ashish Patel have also been invited to these rallies. I met CM Yogi Adityanath and invited him to the rally on March 22. Nishad Party has also demanded declaring a holiday on March 23 for Nishad Raj Jayanti. Lord Ram was born on Navami while Nishad Raj, who was 4 days older, was born on Panchami. It's clear that Sanjay Nishad wants to demonstrate his strength through this political gathering. Expert View Senior journalist Anand Rai says - The Nishad community has significant influence across different sub-castes from UP's eastern border to Delhi NCR. This community has become quite aware over the past two decades. SP had announced the inclusion of 17 OBC castes into Dalit category during the end of their rule. The Nishad community has long been demanding inclusion in SC. While there is still a year until the UP elections, the Nishad Party has already started preparing its ground. The Nishad Party is currently with the ruling NDA. In the past, Sanjay Nishad has also shown aggression to include the Nishad community in SC, but for some time now he has appeared quite balanced. Rallies mean pressure politics However, senior journalist Harshvardhan Shahi from Purvanchal raises questions about these events. He sharply asks what Sanjay Nishad needs to explain- They should explain these things to their community in these rallies. Apart from pressure politics while being in power, I don't see anything else behind these rallies. This time, the caste census will determine how many people belong to which community. After this, it will be decided who will be the inspector from that particular community? Is it easy to get Kevat-Mallah registered from OBC to SC? The Constitution only recognizes 4 categories - General, SC, ST and OBC. This community is registered as Majhwar in SC category at number 53 in the Constitution's list. Kevat, Mallah, Bind, Kashyap, Dhimar, Turaiha, Majhwar, Dhimar, Manjhi, Raikwar, Batham, Kahar, Godia, Gangota, Gangai, Beldar are its sub-castes. In the Census Manual 1961 also, Kevat, Mallah, Manjhi were counted under Majhwar SC, just like Mochi is counted in SC. In 2022, CM Yogi wrote a letter to the Registrar General of India asking whether Nishad belongs to OBC or SC. In response, it was stated that they are listed in the SC category in the census manual. The nodal department has to issue directions after taking a decision from the Ministry of Social Justice. Based on this, people of the community can register their name as Majhwar in the caste column during the caste census. Based on the Majhwar certificate, in 2014, Ramcharit Nishad came from Delhi and was elected as MP from Machhlishahr reserved parliamentary seat on BJP ticket. This clearly means that in many states, the Nishad community is included in SC. Now the Officer's Statement Census work director Sheetal Verma says - In this, self-declared caste can be given prominence instead of surname. However, the benefit of reservation based on the declared caste will only be available when the concerned Tehsildar issues the certificate for that category. How influential are Nishads in UP?

stories.title: Opium crop worth ₹40 crore destroyed due to rain:Wheat-mustard crops damaged in 25 districts of UP; farmers say we are ruined
stories.summary: Unseasonal storms, rain and hail have caused heavy damage to crops in UP. Wheat, mustard and poppy crops have fallen in the fields. In Barabanki, adjacent to the capital Lucknow, poppy worth more than ₹40 crores was destroyed. Farmers say- Our crops have been destroyed due to unseasonal rain. If it rains like this for 2-3 more days, we will be desperate for every grain. Wheat and mustard were ripe and ready. But the rain ruined everything. Looking at the untimely rain, the Chief Minister has asked all District Magistrates to personally go into the field. They should assess the situation and immediately evaluate crop damage in affected areas. He strictly stated, This work should not just be on paper but based on ground reality, so that farmers can get proper and timely assistance. In UP, it rained in 23 districts within 24 hours. More than 8 areas experienced heavy hailstorms. 'Dainik Bhaskar' reached the Barabanki district and tried to understand the troubles and pain of farmers. Read the report... In Barabanki, opium pods turned black, and seeds difficult to extract In Barabanki, we met farmer Indrajeet at the opium field. He was worried. When asked about his concerns, he said that we planted opium in November, and flowers came in March. Now the pods (fruits) had formed. They have to be cut and given to the government in April-May, but now there has been unseasonal rain in March. Due to this, the opium plants that have fallen due to rain and hail, their pods will start rotting. The grain will become weak. If the full crop is not received, loss is certain. Now you understand that the government has nothing to do with the impact of weather, because we will have to give the government as many crops as the quota set by the government. 3,000 farmers grow opium in the district, and all are worried Farmer Surajpal says that only in Barabanki are 3,000 farmers involved in opium cultivation. About 5,000 kg of opium is produced in one season. 1 kg of opium sells for ₹10 to 12 lakh. In one season, its business is worth more than ₹500 crores. Now the problems have increased due to the rain. We asked what happens to the damaged crop? They explained that Government officials come and make them bury the damaged crop in the ground in their presence. Mustard seeds fell due to strong winds, making it now difficult to extract We also spoke to farmer Vikram Prasad. He says, ‘I had sown wheat, mustard, peas, and chickpeas’. This time, there was a slight delay in sowing wheat. The crop was about to be harvested, but it rained. Now the wheat has fallen in the field. After getting wet, the grain will remain weak. The yield will be reduced. The mustard crop was ripe. We had not been able to harvest it yet, and strong winds caused the seeds to fall in the field. Now we won't be able to properly extract the mustard seeds. If it rains like this for 2-3 days, everything will be ruined. Vikram says, ‘Potato farmers have already delivered their crop to cold storage, so they have avoided the losses’. Farmers said, ‘How will we run our households after the loss’? Farmer Virendra Kumar says, ‘Hail with rain has caused problems’. The wheat grain has become wet; if there is more rain, it will be difficult to harvest the crop. Nothing will be usable; we don't get fair prices in the market, and we won't even get compensation for this. Farmers work hard for the crop, but what can we do when the weather turns bad? Not everyone gets the benefit of crop insurance. After the loss that has occurred, we are just thinking about how to run our households. Cucumber crop covered with polythene After talking to farmers, we reached Ramsanehighat. Here we met farmer Rajan, who says, ‘We had sown mustard in the field’. Today it rained with hail. We had harvested some mustard, but extracting seeds from what remains in the fields will be difficult. The adjacent field had a cucumber crop. It was covered with polythene to protect it. Here, farmer Priyanshu says, ‘The cucumber crop is waterlogged’. If the weather remains like this for 2-3 days, it will be problematic. Because then the crop will start rotting. Now learn about the damage caused by rain in other districts Now know why the weather changed suddenly Heavy rain due to a western disturbance becoming active According to the Meteorological Department, the weather has changed across the state due to the activation of a western disturbance. The weather will remain disturbed for the next 2 days. Winds will blow at a speed of 40 km/hour. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Singh said that due to the western disturbance, there is a possibility of rain across the state. After 2 days, its effect will start decreasing. In the last 24 hours, Mathura experienced the strongest winds at 87 km/hr. Wind speeds of 59 km/hr were recorded in Noida, and 57 km/hr in Agra and Bulandshahr. Maximum rainfall of about 6mm was recorded in Bagpat and Bulandshahr. How will the weather be for 2 days? March 21- Some districts in Western-Eastern UP may experience rain. Winds will blow at 40 km per hour. The temperature may drop by 2-3 degrees. March 22- Most districts in Western-Eastern UP will remain cloudy. Rain may occur in some places. Strong winds will also blow. Rain in more than 25 districts in 24 hours; maximum rainfall in Mathura-Aligarh, clouds poured in Bagpat

stories.title: UP captain martyred while saving fellow soldier:Caught in strong river current; father says, 'head hit a rock'
stories.summary: A 25-year-old Army Captain from Ghazipur in Uttar Pradesh lost his life while saving a fellow soldier in Dehradun. On March 20, during a training session, he was swept away by the strong current of a river. Captain Prashant Chaurasia immediately jumped into the river and managed to rescue his companion. However, he himself got caught in the current and was injured after hitting a rock. His fellow soldiers pulled him out and rushed him to an Army hospital, where he died during treatment on March 22. On hearing the news, his mother Suman Devi fainted. His mortal remains were brought from Dehradun to Babatpur Airport in Varanasi on Monday and then taken to Ghazipur in an Army vehicle. Hundreds of people joined the funeral procession. His last rites were performed at Balua Ghat around 4:30 pm, with his younger brother Mayank Chaurasia performing the final rituals. Upon reaching Ghazipur, the mortal remains of martyred Captain Prashant Chaurasia were first placed at the Ramlila Ground in Zamania. There, a large number of people paid their last respects. After this, the mortal remains were taken to his ancestral home. During this time, former MLA of the area, Sunita Singh, also arrived and paid tribute to the martyred Captain. Prashant was selected in NDA, 4 years ago Captain Prashant Chaurasia was from Zamania town. He received his primary education from St. Mary's School here. He was selected for the National Defence Academy (NDA) in 2022. His elder sister, Saloni, got married just last month. His younger brother, Mayank, stays at home and studies. Father says, ‘Son died due to head injury’ Captain's father, Purushottam Chaurasia, said that Zamania's CO called me and asked if there was any information about Prashant. After this, I called my son Prashant. His friend answered the phone. He said please come here immediately. He also sent two flight tickets. After that, we reached Delhi in the morning by flight. From there, we went to Dehradun. Upon reaching there, we were told that on March 20, while crossing the river, Prashant was trying to save his drowning companion. During that time, he got caught in the strong current. This caused an injury to his head, and he died. Meanwhile, Lieutenant General Anindya Sengupta of Surya Command, GOC-in-C, and all ranks of Surya Command have paid tribute to Captain Prashant Kumar Chaurasia, who sacrificed his life during a river crossing exercise. They said that in this hour of grief, the Indian Army stands completely united with the bereaved family. His courage and dedication symbolize the highest traditions of service. This will continue to inspire generations to come.

When the girl's family arrived at the scene, she clung to them and started crying. People started protesting regarding the Maulana's arrest. Police, who arrived on receiving the information, apprehended the accused and took him away. The incident occurred in the Kalyanpur police station area. Called home on the pretext of giving chocolate Regarding the matter, Trainee IPS Kalyanpur Station Officer Sumedh Jadhav said, Based on the complaint of the victim's family, a case will be registered under POCSO and other serious sections, and he will be sent to jail. The incident was captured on CCTV. The accused, Mohd. Ismail, was sent to jail on Monday.

stories.title: Shankaracharya forms 2.18 lakh-strong Chaturangini Sena:Says force will protect cows, scriptures, and temples
stories.summary: In Varanasi, Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati on Monday announced the formation of the Chaturangini Sena, which will include 2,18,700 soldiers recruited from across the country. He said the force will work for cow protection, dharma protection, scripture protection, and temple protection. Members will wear yellow attire and carry a Parashu (axe). He also formed the Shri Shankaracharya Chaturangini Sabha to organise the Sena. The body will have 27 members, with Avimukteshwaranand himself as president. Shankaracharya explained the working methods of his army. He said, First, 'Toko', meaning they will object/intervene. Say that this is wrong. If they don't agree, then 'Roko' (stop them). Brother, you will have to stop. Otherwise, then 'Thoko' (strike/hit). 'Thoko' does not mean direct assault. Filing a lawsuit, complaining, and holding a panchayat will also come under 'Thoko'. They will work by adopting all these constitutional methods. Shankaracharya said - There will be 10 people in one team Shankaracharya said, There will be 10 people in 1 'patti' (team). If 21 thousand 870 teams are formed, an army will be ready. Currently, there are about 800 districts in India. If 27 teams, i.e., 270 people, are prepared in each district, then 2 lakh 16 thousand people will be ready. 'Only those who believe in that religion should go to religious premises' Regarding the ban on entry of non-Hindus into the Badrinath Temple and Kedarnath Temple temples in Uttarakhand, Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati said that in Mecca and Medina, people of other religions are stopped 40 km before, and that is not wrong. He added that similarly Hindus also want to maintain the sanctity of their religious places and worship in their own way, and according to tradition, only believers of the religion should enter such premises. Why did Shankaracharya need to form the Chaturangini Sena?

stories.title: Wheat MSP increased by ₹160 in UP:Power plant to start in Kanpur, Gorakhpur to become solar city; 35 cabinet proposals approved
stories.summary: A cabinet meeting chaired by Yogi Adityanath was held on Monday, where 35 out of 37 proposals were approved. Giving a major boost to farmers, the government increased the Minimum Support Price (MSP) of wheat by Rs 160 per quintal. Announcing the decisions, Agriculture Minister Surya Pratap Shahi said wheat procurement will run from March 30 to June 15 across Uttar Pradesh through 6,500 procurement centres. The MSP has been fixed at Rs 2,585 per quintal, up from Rs 2,425 last year. The procurement target is 50 lakh metric tonnes, and registration portals have been opened to curb middlemen. Procurement will be handled by 8 agencies, including Food Corporation of India (FCI), UP Mandi Parishad, PCF, PCU, UPSS, NAFED, and NCCF. Solar city plan, power unit cleared The Cabinet also approved the Navyug Palika Yojana to make Gorakhpur a Solar City and upgrade municipalities in 58 districts, cleared the proposal to start the third 660 MW unit in Ghatampur, and cancelled proposals related to the sugar industry and Lakhimpur. Key decisions of Yogi Adityanath cabinet 1. Rs 2,242.90 crore approved for Ghatampur Power Plant Urban Development Minister Arvind Sharma said three 660 MW units are planned at Ghatampur; two are operational, and the third will start soon. The Cabinet approved Rs 2,242.90 crore to operate a coal block in Jharkhand, which will supply 270 million tons of coal to the plant. Power cost from Ghatampur is currently Rs3.71/unit, expected to drop by Rs1/unit after coal supply begins. 2. Navayug Palika Yojana approved for 58 district municipalities The Cabinet approved the Navayug Palika Yojana announced in the budget to modernize municipalities at district headquarters in 58 districts, excluding 17 municipal corporations among the state’s 75 districts. The scheme aims to improve urban infrastructure and facilities, with a Rs145 crore budget over five years. 3. Gorakhpur to become solar city A 20 MW floating solar plant will be installed at Chilua Taal by Coal India Limited to make Gorakhpur a Solar City. About 80 acres of land have been acquired. Earlier floating plants include a 20 MW plant by NTPC Limited in Auraiya district and an 11 MW plant by THDC India Limited in Khurja. 4. Land to be provided for private business parks Finance Minister Suresh Khanna said the private business park development scheme has been approved to boost industrial growth and employment. The government will provide land to investors, with payment recoverable in installments over 45 years. Under the Uttar Pradesh Multimodal Logistics Park Policy, a multimodal logistics park will be developed in Budhaki; tenders will be issued within three months. The project will benefit from proximity to Dadri and Noida International Airport, boost exports, and support inter-state goods movement through a large warehousing hub. 5. A 10,000-capacity convention centre to be built in Lucknow A convention centre with 10,000 seating capacity will be built in Vrindavan Yojana for Rs 1,435.25 crore. It will include a 2,500-seat auditorium, dining facilities for 5,000 people, and a hotel. 6. Rs 305 crore flyover approved on Lucknow–Hardoi road A flyover will be built at Dubagga on the Lucknow–Hardoi road for Rs 305.31 crore. The flyover will be 1,811.72 metres long and is expected to reduce congestion and ease commuting. Other major decisions of the cabinet

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Prayagraj cold storage building collapse kills 4; PM warns of prolonged West Asia crisis in LS address more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Cold storage building collapses in Prayagraj, 4 dead: 17 rescued from debris, rescue underway; eyewitnesses say they heard a blast In Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, a cold storage building collapsed on Monday afternoon at around 1:30 pm following a loud explosion. Around 20 workers were trapped under the debris. So far, 4 workers died, and 17 people have been rescued, while several others are still feared trapped. 2. PM Modi warns of prolonged global strain due to the West Asia crisis PM Modi described the ongoing conflict in West Asia as ‘worrisome’ during his address to the Lok Sabha. He warned of a prolonged period of global uncertainty, saying the difficult situation may continue for a long time due to the war. 3. Yogi Adityanath cabinet to meet today: 23 proposals on agenda; council of ministers meeting also scheduled CM Yogi Adityanath will chair a cabinet meeting today where over 23 proposals will be discussed. A proposal to form an OBC commission for Panchayat elections may also come up, though it is not listed in the official agenda. 4. Trump halts attacks on Iran’s energy sites for 5 days US President Trump said the US and Iran have held “very good and productive” discussions over the past two days to resolve Middle East hostilities. He has instructed the Department of War to delay all military strikes on Iranian power plants and energy infrastructure for 5 days. 5. KC Tyagi joins Rashtriya Lok Dal after nearly two decades: Jayant Chaudhary inducts him, aims to revive base in western UP Veteran leader KC Tyagi, after nearly two decades with Janata Dal (United), joined RLD in Delhi. Party chief Jayant Chaudhary welcomed him and his son Amrish Tyagi, calling the return natural and aimed at strengthening the party in western UP. 6. Jobs of 1.86 lakh UP teachers at risk: Clear UP-TET or complete SIR and census targets Around 1.86 lakh teachers in Uttar Pradesh have not cleared the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET). They teach Classes 1–8, and 50,000 cannot even appear due to lacking minimum qualifications. The Supreme Court of India has set September 2027 as the deadline to pass TET. 7. NDA announces TN pre-poll alliance NDA finalised its Tamil Nadu pre-poll seat-sharing for the April 23 assembly elections. AIADMK gets the largest share, BJP 27 seats, PMK 18, and AMMK 11 seats. 8. Only 40% bloom on mango trees in Malihabad: cold weather delays crop, farmers expect higher prices In Malihabad, the mango belt of UP, blossoms have appeared on only 40–50% of trees this season due to cold weather. Farmers are spraying medicines to boost flowering and expect higher prices this year. 9. Woman kills mother-in-law in Lucknow: planned murder as robbery with lover Police revealed that Ranjana Verma (36) and her lover Rajan Sharma (21) planned the murder of her 69-year-old mother-in-law three days in advance. After strangling her at home, they removed and hid the jewellery to make the crime appear like a robbery. 10. IPL broadcast ban in Bangladesh under review The ban on broadcasting the IPL in Bangladesh may soon be reconsidered. The country’s Minister of State for Youth and Sports, Aminul Haque, has indicated that the government will review the situation and understand the reasons behind the earlier decision.

stories.title: Cold storage building collapses in Prayagraj, 4 dead:17 rescued from debris, rescue underway; eyewitnesses say they heard a blast
stories.summary: In Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, a cold storage building collapsed on Monday afternoon at around 1:30 pm following a loud explosion. Around 20 workers were trapped under the debris. So far, 17 people have been rescued, while several others are still feared trapped. In the incident, four workers died. The deceased have been identified as Pilat Chaudhary, Mashinder, Jyotish, and Jagdish. Jagdish was a resident of Prayagraj, while the other three were from Bihar. However, the administration has not yet officially confirmed the deaths. The administration is carrying out the rescue operation using seven JCB machines, while teams from SDRF and NDRF are present at the site. Eyewitnesses said, First, there was an explosion in the ammonia gas storage tank. Due to this, the RCC pillar structure collapsed, and then the entire building came crashing down. Pictures related to the incident Cold storage built on 5,000 sq ft land The building, operating under the name Adarsh Cold Storage, was located in the Phaphamau area of Prayagraj. It is owned by Samajwadi Party leader and former minister Ansar Ahmad. The 27-year-old facility comprised three structures, one of which—spread over nearly 10,000 sq ft—collapsed. Workers present at time of incident More than 100 people were working at the site. At the time of the incident, some labourers were having their meal while others were resting when the structure suddenly gave way. Detentions and compensation announced Police have detained the cold storage manager and several members of Ansar Ahmad’s family for questioning. Narendra Modi and Yogi Adityanath have expressed grief over the incident and announced ex-gratia compensation of ₹2 lakh each for the families of the deceased and ₹50,000 for the injured.

stories.title: 70-year-old Maulana abuses child in Madrasa:Muzaffarnagar SP says video shows him doing dirty acts; accused arrested
stories.summary: In UP's Muzaffarnagar, a 70-year-old Maulana sexually assaulted an 11-year-old child in a madrasa. Someone recorded a video of the Maulana's misconduct inside the madrasa and made it viral. When the video reached the child's family, they were shocked. Upon questioning the minor, he narrated his ordeal. According to police, the victim told his family that the Maulana taught him Urdu. After class, he would detain him under the pretext of some work or cleaning. Then he would take him to another room and sexually assault him. He would threaten that if he told anyone about this, it wouldn't be good. The video is said to be from Eid night, March 21. Based on the family's complaint, a case has been registered against the accused Maulana under various sections including POCSO. The Maulana was arrested late Sunday night and sent to jail. The incident occurred in Shahpur police station area, 25 kilometers away from the district headquarters. SP Rural Aditya Bansal said- In the video, Maulana Iqbal, who teaches at Islamia Madrasa, is seen sexually assaulting a minor student. Efforts will be made to ensure the strictest punishment for Maulana in this case. See the pictures... Now know the full matter In the Shahpur police station area, Maulana Iqbal (70) has been providing religious education at Islamia Madrasa for the past 40 years. An 11-year-old boy from the same area has been studying here for the past 5 years. It is alleged that the boy was in the madrasa on the night of Eid. The Maulana committed indecent acts with him that night as well. Meanwhile, someone recorded a video of the Maulana's actions. After the video surfaced, the father took the boy to the police station. He filed a complaint with the police and submitted the video as evidence. Police arrested the accused Maulana late Sunday night. Now know what is in the video? In the 1 minute 59 second video, Maulana Iqbal is seen with a child in a madrasa room. The child is lying on the bed. Maulana is nude and performing obscene acts. The child is resisting, but Maulana appears to be using force.
